title: Wuxia — two swordfighters in a bamboo forest, one exchange
useCase: Period drama teaser, game cinematic, Chinese-language short

anchor.subject: Two robed swordsmen facing each other in rain
anchor.scene: A dense bamboo forest, pale mist, wet leaves
anchor.motion: One rushes, they exchange blades once, both hold a still beat
anchor.camera: Wide locked-off first, then a fast push in on the clash
anchor.audio: Bamboo creak, rain, a single blade ring
anchor.light: Flat overcast light with mist layers between the trunks

seedance-2.0.prompt: Two robed swordsmen face each other at a distance in a dense bamboo forest under flat overcast light, pale mist layered between the trunks and rain falling steadily. The swordsman on the left, in pale grey robes with sleeves bound at the wrist, rushes forward in three quick steps; the swordsman on the right, in deep indigo robes, turns his blade to meet the strike. Steel meets once with a clean ring, both hold their blades locked for a beat, then step back and return to a guard stance. Wet bamboo leaves tremble and rain streaks catch the light. The camera is locked off wide for the approach, then pushes in fast on the clash and settles. Classical wuxia realism, natural fabrics weighted by rain, no wire stunts, no acrobatics, no flying, no blood, no duplicated fighters, no subtitles.
seedance-2.0.notes: Explicitly forbid wire work and flight; without it the model adds floating for anything labelled wuxia.
